<!--
Template for the API pages. scripts/make_pages.R creates one page per API
in api/, which sets `api_id` and includes this file.
-->

```{r}
source("R/status.R")
status <- read_status()
apis <- read_apis()
api <- apis$apis[[match(api_id, vapply(apis$apis, `[[`, "", "id"))]]
eps <- endpoint_table(api)
users <- api_packages(api, status)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
md(api$description %||% "")
md("Base url: `", api$base_url, "`",
   if (!is.null(api$docs)) paste0(" · [Documentation](", api$docs, ")"),
   if (!is.null(api$website)) paste0(" · [Website](", api$website, ")"))
md("Checked ", updated(apis), ". ",
   if (!is.null(api$baseline_recorded)) paste0("Responses are compared with the baseline recorded on ", substr(api$baseline_recorded, 1, 10), ".")
   else "There is no baseline yet, so changes can not be detected.")
if (!is.null(api$token_expires)) md("Endpoints that need a login are checked with an ICES token that expires on ", substr(api$token_expires, 1, 10), ".")
```

## Used by

```{r}
#| results: asis
md("**Directly:** ", if (length(users$direct)) paste(package_link(users$direct, status, from = "api"), collapse = ", ") else "none")
md("**Through a dependency:** ", if (length(users$via)) paste(package_link(users$via, status, from = "api"), collapse = ", ") else "none")
```

## Notes

```{r}
#| results: asis
if (length(api$notes)) {
  md_table(data.frame(
    Topic = vapply(api$notes, `[[`, "", "topic"),
    Observation = vapply(api$notes, `[[`, "", "observation"),
    Affects = vapply(api$notes, function(n) n$affects %||% "", "")
  ))
} else {
  md("No notes.")
}
```

## Endpoints checked

```{r}
#| results: asis
md_table(
  data.frame(
    Endpoint = sprintf("[%s](#%s)", eps$name, gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", tolower(eps$name))),
    Status = vapply(eps$status, function(s) as.character(badge(api_status_label[[s]], api_status_colour[[s]])), ""),
    HTTP = eps$http_status,
    `Time (s)` = eps$time_s,
    `Size (kB)` = eps$size_kb,
    Records = eps$records,
    Fields = eps$fields,
    check.names = FALSE
  ),
  align = "llrrrrr"
)
```

## Changes since the baseline

```{r}
#| results: asis
changes <- unlist(lapply(api$endpoints, function(e) {
  vapply(e$changes, function(ch) paste0("**", e$name, "**: ", ch$text), "")
}))
errors <- unlist(lapply(api$endpoints, function(e) if (!is.null(e$error)) paste0("**", e$name, "**: ", e$error)))
skipped <- unlist(lapply(api$endpoints, function(e) if (!is.null(e$skipped)) paste0("**", e$name, "**: not checked, ", e$skipped)))
md_list(c(errors, changes, skipped), empty = "No changes: every endpoint returns the same structure as the baseline.")
```

## Documented operations

```{r}
#| results: asis
sp <- api$spec
if (is.null(sp)) {
  md("No machine-readable documentation, so changes to the operations and parameters are not checked.")
} else if (!is.null(sp$error)) {
  md("The [documentation](", sp$url, ") could not be read: ", sp$error)
} else {
  ops <- Filter(function(o) !isTRUE(o$undocumented), api$operations)
  n_checked <- sum(vapply(ops, function(o) length(o$checked) > 0, logical(1)))
  md("The [documentation](", api$docs %||% sp$url, ") (", sp$title, " ", sp$version, ") lists ",
     length(ops), " operations, of which ", n_checked, " are checked here. ",
     if (length(sp$changes)) "Changes since the baseline:" else "No changes to the operations or their parameters since the baseline.")
  md_list(unlist(sp$changes), empty = "")
  md_table(data.frame(
    Operation = vapply(ops, function(o) paste0("`", o$method, " ", o$path, "`"), ""),
    Parameters = vapply(ops, function(o) if (length(o$parameters)) paste(unlist(o$parameters), collapse = "<br>") else "", ""),
    Checked = vapply(ops, function(o) paste(unlist(o$checked), collapse = ", "), "")
  ))
}
```

## R functions

```{r}
#| results: asis
ops <- api$operations
fns <- api$functions
fn <- function(x) if (length(x)) paste0("`", unlist(x), "()`", collapse = ", ") else ""
read_ops <- Filter(function(o) !isTRUE(o$writes), ops)
n_mapped <- sum(vapply(read_ops, function(o) length(o$endpoint_functions) > 0, logical(1)))
md("The packages are designed with one R function for each endpoint, and further ",
   "functions that combine endpoints into a dataset. Functions are found by reading the code of ",
   paste(package_link(unlist(api$packages), status, from = "api"), collapse = ", "), ". ",
   n_mapped, " of the ", length(read_ops), " operations that read data have an R function; ",
   "a function name is suggested for the others.")
md("### Operations and R functions")
md_table(data.frame(
  Operation = vapply(ops, function(o) paste0("`", o$method, " ", o$path, "`", if (isTRUE(o$undocumented)) " (not documented)" else ""), ""),
  `R function` = vapply(ops, function(o) {
    if (length(o$endpoint_functions)) fn(o$endpoint_functions)
    else if (isTRUE(o$writes)) "*none: uploads or changes data*"
    else paste0("**missing**: suggest `", o$suggested, "()`")
  }, ""),
  `Also used in` = vapply(ops, function(o) fn(o$combined_functions), ""),
  check.names = FALSE
))
combined <- Filter(function(f) f$kind == "combined", fns)
md("### Combined functions")
if (length(combined)) {
  md_table(data.frame(
    Function = vapply(combined, function(f) fn(f$name), ""),
    `Builds on` = vapply(combined, function(f) fn(f$uses), ""),
    Operations = vapply(combined, function(f) paste0("`", sub("^[A-Z]+ ", "", unlist(c(f$operations, f$other_operations))), "`", collapse = ", "), ""),
    check.names = FALSE
  ))
} else {
  md("None.")
}
```

## Endpoint details

```{r}
#| results: asis
for (e in api$endpoints) {
  md("### ", e$name, ' {#', gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", tolower(e$name)), '}')
  md("`", e$url, "`")
  if (length(e$functions)) md("Called by: ", paste0("`", unlist(e$functions), "()`", collapse = ", "))
  if (!is.null(e$operation)) md("Operation: `", e$operation, "`")
  if (isTRUE(e$auth)) md("Needs an ICES login.")
  info <- c(
    if (!is.null(e$http_status)) paste("HTTP", e$http_status),
    if (!is.null(e$content_type) && nzchar(e$content_type)) e$content_type,
    if (!is.null(e$time_s)) paste(e$time_s, "s"),
    if (!is.null(e$records)) paste(e$records, "records")
  )
  if (length(info)) md(paste(info, collapse = " · "))
  if (length(e$fields)) {
    md('::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Response structure: ', length(e$fields), ' fields"}')
    md_table(data.frame(
      Field = paste0("`", names(e$fields), "`"),
      Type = vapply(e$fields, function(t) paste(unlist(t), collapse = " | "), "")
    ), row.names = FALSE)
    md(":::")
  }
}
```
